title: ipheion bivalve
intro: Ipheion bivalve, commonly known as the "wild onion", is a species of flowering plant that belongs to the Amaryllidaceae family. It is traditionally used to treat various health issues, including respiratory problems, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Ipheion bivalve include its ability to relieve coughs, reduce congestion, and soothe digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of Ipheion bivalve include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
